name: Swimlanes with time
why: A Gantt view of the run. Each lane is one executor: Agent, Human, Tool. Each step run is a bar in time order, so loops show as repeated bars. A NOW line ends the time axis, with dashed next bars. A small graph strip shows the whole workflow. Best for time and who works. Weak for the graph shape.
